caption: The drawing depicts a wrought iron balcony railing attached to a building wall. The railing features intricate, ornamental designs, including swirling and geometric patterns. Above the railing, there are three rectangular window shutters, each divided into vertical slats and partially open outward. The building wall is illustrated with horizontal lines suggesting stone or brick construction. The image is composed primarily in brown and black ink lines on a light beige background, with some shading and cross-hatching used to suggest shadows and depth. The words "WROUGHT IRON BALCONY RAILING" are written in all capital letters in the bottom right corner of the drawing. The entire composition is framed by a single, simple rectangular border.
title: Wrought Iron Balcony Rail
